messages:
noah: FYI there's someone at the door with a squeaky suitcase wheel and a box labeled "fragile" but no host listed. they asked if there's anywhere to sit while they wait
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in attempt: name=Ethan Lin, host=unknown, ETA=2m, badge_status=pending
noah: also they smell like mango cake? not sure if that's relevant :cake:
liz: if they're unaffiliated we usually ask them to sign the visitor log and wait on the bench by the elevator
pat: bench is full of people doing calls. can we clear the phone pod for a minute?
maria: I'm in the phone pod but i can move to meeting room B for 10 mins. someone put my name on the pod? :raised_hand:
noah: thanks maria! front desk, can you hold the package and page the floors please
frontdesk-bot: Package logged: id=PKG-9001, desc="fragile - glass sticker", location=secure-hold, note=unlabeled-receiver
frontdesk-bot: Badge kiosk status: READY. Quick troubleshooting if kiosk shows red light: unplug USB scanner -> wait 5s -> plug back in -> kioskctl restart
liz: kiosk just gave a red beep. I'm sending the visitor to bench and asking them to wait for a host DM
pat: small ping: can we have a sticker sheet by the mail shelf that says "Fragile - please label"? we've been getting loose glass jars lately
facilities-bot: Ticket created: FACL-229 - "Fragile sticker sheet for mail shelf" assigned to @facilities, ETA 3 business days
noah: visitor said their host is "Sam H" from growth, can someone check floor 3?\maria: pinging Sam H. also marveling at mango cake aroma :joy:
pat: also heads up: stroller parked in lobby again (tiny kid demo), front desk suggested moving it to storage. anyone claiming?
liz: that's ours - demo from vendor, i'll retrieve it after the meeting.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor badge printed: badge_id=B-3345, holder=Ethan Lin, allowed_areas=lobby,conference-guest
noah: badge printed. Ethan seated at bench, brought a slice of mango cake and offered to share. defenses down. who wants cake? :cake::thinking:
maria: i'll take a sliver, happy to donate my pod time to pat while i eat
pat: cake accepted. thanks Ethan :cake:
noah: quick note for ops: if a guest brings food and leaves unlabelled containers in fridge, please add sticker request to the note above :wink:
facilities-bot: Update: FACL-229 in progress - sticker sheets printing scheduled
liz: thanks everyone. small win: stroller moved to storage and bench is free for the next 20m
pat: kudos to front desk for quick handling, Kris did great :clap:
end of thread
